chars.ADIL: ADIL: a 17-year-old Moroccan boy, short black curly hair, wearing a bright red hoodie with white drawstrings and black joggers
chars.HIBA: HIBA: an 18-year-old Moroccan girl, long dark wavy hair, wearing a mustard yellow puffer jacket over a white top and blue jeans
chars.DIRECTOR: DIRECTOR: a stern Moroccan school director in his 50s, balding with grey moustache and rectangular glasses, wearing a dark brown suit with a burgundy tie

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: In a small modern apartment living room in Casablanca, HIBA and ADIL sit on a sofa; HIBA stares in panic at her ringing smartphone held up between them, ADIL leans in shocked, both frozen in fear, evening lamp light

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Night, outside the door of a Moroccan apartment building, DIRECTOR stands with a phone pressed to his ear, furious face, other hand on his hip, glaring at the closed door

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: HIBA rushes out of the apartment door grabbing her bag and phone in a hurry, looking back worried, ADIL stands in the hallway helpless with hands on his head

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: ADIL alone in his small bedroom at night, sitting on the edge of the bed, staring anxiously at his phone, sweat on his forehead, dim light

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: A Moroccan clinic waiting corridor, DIRECTOR walks fast holding HIBA firmly by the arm, his face angry and suspicious, HIBA looks down scared and ashamed

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Inside a Moroccan family living room, HIBA in tears pointing aside while confessing, DIRECTOR standing over her shouting with clenched fist, tense dramatic light

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: Night in a narrow Moroccan neighborhood street (derb) with old buildings, ADIL chats with two neighborhood boys under a street lamp, a dark sedan car with headlights on slowly stops beside them

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Night Moroccan street, DIRECTOR leans out of the driver window of a dark sedan glaring with cold anger, ADIL stands by the car frozen in terror, wide eyes, street lamp light
